title: The Wolf and the Fox
summary: A fox squeezed through a narrow hole into a peasant's pantry, eating moderately of bread and cheese before slipping back out easily....
full_text:
A fox squeezed through a narrow hole into a peasant's pantry, eating moderately of bread and cheese before slipping back out easily.

He showed the hole to a greedy wolf, who gorged himself on ham and sausages until his belly swelled like a balloon.

When the farmer opened the door with an axe, the wolf tried to flee through the hole, but became wedged tight, unable to move forward or back.

"Farewell, friend," whispered the nimble fox. "Had you checked your appetite, you could have escaped as easily as I did!"
moral: Greed that gorges beyond measure traps the body in its own snare.
